assertions.name: the (1,1) block's factor lambda_- + d is NEGATIVE for every bond — the state sum is signed, not a partition function
while the total z + d is positive for every bond, so L is real — the positive block simply outweighs the negative one
the required offset d > 1/q lies on the OTHER SIDE OF ZERO from every letter the algebra has (all d <= 0)
and that holds for every q > 0, not only at q0 — 1/q > 0 always, so no q rescues the sign
no real E_- satisfies exp(-E_-) = lambda_- + d, so the (1,1) block has no energy and the Legendre structure F = U - TS is absent
(lambda_+ + d_pn) + (lambda_- + d_pn) = h + 2 d_pn = h*delta/2 exactly — the pn letter is the near-null vector of the UNWEIGHTED block sum, surviving in z + d only because w_+ != w_-

description: Asks the prior question behind rem:bond-log-ratio-is-a-free-energy's open claim that B = alpha L is the binding energy. A free energy is -kT log Z with Z a sum of POSITIVE Boltzmann factors, and that positivity is what makes F a Legendre transform with an internal energy and an entropy. Measured at 200 bits: the (1,1) block's factor lambda_- + d = -1/q + d is NEGATIVE for all three bonds (-0.900918283956, -1.005376531725, -1.109978582751), while the total z + d stays positive because the (2) block outweighs it. Positivity would need d > 1/q, and the algebra's letters satisfy -h <= d <= 0, so the required offset is on the other side of zero from all of them -- for every q > 0, since 1/q > 0 always. Hence no real E_- has exp(-E_-) = lambda_- + d, the (1,1) block has no energy, and there is no U or S for alpha L to be. L itself is untouched and no number moves; what fails is the identification. Also recorded: the pn factors nearly cancel, summing to h*delta/2 = 1.4380325618674e-4 exactly.
caveats: Nothing is retracted. L remains a correct, exactly computable, convention-D canonical quantity in all 80 files that compute it; the free-energy DESCRIPTION is also correct, since signed free energies over quasi-probabilities are legitimate objects.

The Gibbs-Helmholtz corollary in the docstring (U ~ 0 if one grants kT = alpha) is INDICATIVE ONLY and is not asserted here: varying q changes the block eigenvalues as well as the scale, so q is not a pure temperature. The finding needs no temperature.
No new binding formula. This removes a candidate justification; it does not supply one, and says nothing about the Reeb-flow or Wigner channels.
